The Pudgy Penguin Soulbound Token migration tool is now live on The Huddle.

As part of this migration, holders of the ‘Box Burnooor’ SBT will have the opportunity to claim a free @vibes_tcg Table for Two Booster Box.

More details below 👇 https://t.co/exYzAyT4bn

Remember those mystery boxes we burned during the Abstract era?

Looks like every SBT holder is now eligible to claim one TCG Box.

We burned $100 back then, and now we're getting a $150 pack with free shipping. Not a bad deal at all.

Huge props to the Pudgy team for looking https://t.co/TmFGrrAWGx
